tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: MIC and MBC values of alapropoginine against the four bacterial strains employed in the study.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Hemolytic activity of alapropoginine against human erythrocytes after 60 minutes’ incubation. The results were recorded at λ = 450 nm.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: The minimum inhibitory and minimum bactericidal concentrations (µg/mL) of the eight antibiotics against the tested bacterial strains.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Combinatorial antimicrobial activity of alapropoginine and antibiotics including the fractional inhibitory concentrations (FIC) indices for the antimicrobial combinations against tested bacterial species. MICs are expressed in µg/mL.
